records.rationale: The source/target word positions can be represented as references while retaining WordNet's own pointer type and tuple.
records.loss_guard: Do not collapse lexical pointers into synset relations.

records.rationale: The 0000 tuple can be retained as a synset-to-synset reference without inventing grammatical meaning.
records.loss_guard: Retain the exact pointer symbol; references alone are not its semantics.

records.rationale: Alternative-to can carry an addressable project edge, but it is deliberately weaker than WordNet antonymy.
records.loss_guard: Never replace the source symbol or label with the generic edge.

records.rationale: The generic edge may support navigation, but WordNet's adjective-cluster organization remains the governing meaning.
records.loss_guard: Do not treat related_to as equivalence, similarity metric or grammatical relation.

records.rationale: A reference can preserve the edge while the source-defined pertainym type remains separately identified.
records.loss_guard: Do not infer morphology, syntax or GB government from a pertainym pointer.

records.rationale: The generic provenance relation is directionally useful, but WordNet's derivationally-related relation is not automatically a transformation history.
records.loss_guard: Retain the WordNet relation as source data and do not claim a derivation algorithm.

records.rationale: A context classification edge may point at the topical synset while retaining the source domain relation.
records.loss_guard: Do not interpret a WordNet topic as a grammar or syntax context.

records.rationale: The literal source marker can be retained as an annotation and referenced by a selected syntax drive.
records.loss_guard: The project map must not redefine the bytes in the source record or claim a GB rule.

records.rationale: No source-grounded equivalence between a WordNet pointer and GB binding can be established from publisher metadata.
records.loss_guard: Do not construct a binding edge until the governing definition and conditions are reviewed.

records.rationale: Government cannot be inferred from source/target direction, containment, order or topical-domain edges.
records.loss_guard: Preserve the unknown rather than naming a project reference government.
